resources.name: OpenCalphad
resources.notes: Open‑source CALPHAD software. The solver must install and use it to perform equilibrium calculations.

resources.name: Fe-based thermodynamic database
resources.notes: A thermodynamic database file that covers the Fe–Cr–Ni–Mo–N system, e.g. TCFE8 or an equivalent. Obtain it from the OpenCalphad databases page.
